done_when: The browser test run's API uses a higher per-route request limit while production keeps 100 per minute, the rate-limit integration test still proves the 429 response, and the full browser suite passes on GitHub's checks
why: Browser tests on main fail at random because every test shares the API's 100-requests-per-minute limit for each route from one machine, so late tests get too-many-requests and the home screen never loads
